title: Perfectness of supported open pushforward
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open, and T a closed subset of X contained in U. A perfect derived module F on U [def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-derived-category] whose cohomology stalks vanish outside T has perfect R(U.ι)_*F [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: Exact restriction to U is left adjoint to module direct image. Module direct image is fully faithful and preserves K-injective complexes; the corresponding right derived functor is fully faithful. The derived adjunction therefore has invertible counit. Apply exact restriction of this counit to each local strictly perfect model of F to prove that Rj_*F restricted to U is perfect.
At x in U apply open_restriction_perfect_local_models to this perfect restriction, obtaining an ambient neighbourhood and strictly perfect model.

At x outside U use T contained in U to show x lies in V = X minus T, open because T is closed. Apply supported_open_pushforward_complement_zero to obtain zero restriction of Rj_*F on V. Construct the zero cochain complex; it is bounded by 0,0 and every term retracts from the finite free module with zero generators by zero maps. Q of this complex is zero, so IsZero.iso supplies the required local-model isomorphism. The two cases at every point are precisely IsPerfect.

proof_origin.reason: Complete Lean proof of the two-open argument in Stacks 08DP. Both new local components are themselves proved, from Mathlib transport and the existing 08FE comparison; no deferred theorem is introduced.

lean.statement:
theorem supported_open_pushforward_perfect (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTU : T ⊆ (U : Set X))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : U.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))] :
    (∀ F : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme, IsPerfect U.toScheme F →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (x : U.toScheme), x.val ∉ T →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) n).obj F).val.presheaf
            x))) →
      IsPerfect X ((schemeDerivedDirectImage U.ι).obj F))
